description: Continue & finish: send a crew waiting at its HIL gate back to the engineer with guidance — it resumes work on the SAME PR (capped at the amend limit). This is the "Continue" option alongside submit_approval APPROVE (ship) / REJECT (stop). A crew halted at its ship gate is resumed with the notes; refused with pr_merged or pr_closed when its pull request merged or closed after the halt. A crew already running is not refused: the amend is queued (queued: true) and appliesAt says when: next_step (the Engineer reads it before its next step) or ship_card (held on its next ship card as a pending Resume, sent from there). A finished crew is refused with no_pending_approval and a nextStep. Requires `approve` scope. At the amend cap the answer carries atAmendCap: true and amendCap (effect stops_at_cap: every engineer round is used, so the crew stops at its amend-cap card instead of running, and amending it there overrides the cap; overrides_cap: this amend answered that card). Tell the operator amendCap.message and amendCap.nextStep. Only call when the operator explicitly asks to amend/continue — never on your own judgement of the reviews.

crewId.description: The crew id (the crew must be at a pending approval gate).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

mergeBase.description: Ask the engineer to merge the base branch into the crew's branch this round, even when it merges cleanly, and keep base merges allowed on this crew from now on, past a "do not merge the base" in its task or earlier notes. Audited under your name. Only set true when the operator asks for the merge.

notes.description: What the engineer should finish/change — becomes the amend instruction.

postToPullRequest.description: Also post the notes on the crew's pull request as a comment review from AnyForge's GitHub App, where everyone with access to the repository can read them. Omit to follow the company setting, which is off unless an owner turned it on; the result's postToPullRequest says whether AnyForge will post them. The round's amend checklist quotes the notes, so it follows them: the result's amendChecklist is pull_request (a comment on the pull request, refreshed at the ship gate) or crew_only (the crew chat only). Only set true when the operator asks for the notes to appear on the pull request.

quick.description: Send it as a quick amend: for a merge of the base, a rename or a change of up to 20 lines in up to 5 files. The Engineer and CI run, the Architect, QA and Security re-review is skipped, and it uses no engineer round; a round that grows past the limits runs as a full amend and the crew says so. Only at a PR-review card, and never on a security-finding crew (quick_amend_unavailable). Only set true when the operator asks for a quick amend.
